## Main result

strategy selection mechanism: co-ethnics play cooperative equilibria, whereas non-co-ethnics do not.

## What they prove

ethnic diversity impedes public goods provision

## What they only simulate

technology mechanisms that focus on the impact of shared ethnicity on the productivity of teams.

## What they do NOT test

preference mechanisms that emphasize the commonality of tastes within ethnic groups or a greater degree of altruism toward co-ethnics.

## What we need to reproduce

experimental games

## How our project differs

emphasis is not on whether ethnic diversity undermines public goods provision, but on why.
